panels.title: Drift detections per agent
panels.description: Count of emitted OPTWIN alerts per minute. An absent alert means no detected drift in the selected data.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(occurred_at,'1m'), agent_id AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM other_events WHERE event_type = 'drift.detected' AND data->>'detector' = 'optwin' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Historical vs recent error rate
panels.description: Error rates in both subwindows at each detected drift.

targets.rawSql: SELECT occurred_at AS time, agent_id || ' history' AS metric, (data->'details'->>'history_error_rate')::float AS value FROM other_events WHERE event_type = 'drift.detected' AND data->>'detector' = 'optwin' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) UNION ALL SELECT occurred_at AS time, agent_id || ' recent' AS metric, (data->'details'->>'recent_error_rate')::float AS value FROM other_events WHERE event_type = 'drift.detected' AND data->>'detector' = 'optwin' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Reviewed error stream
panels.description: Error rate monitored by OPTWIN, per minute and agent, including intervals without drift alerts.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(occurred_at,'1m'), agent_id AS metric, avg((data->>'error')::numeric) AS value FROM other_events WHERE event_type = 'classifier.error' AND data->>'detector' = 'online_bls' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Window sizes at detection
panels.description: Sample counts of the historical and recent OPTWIN subwindows when an alert is emitted.

targets.rawSql: SELECT occurred_at AS time, agent_id || ' history' AS metric, (data->'details'->>'history_size')::int AS value FROM other_events WHERE event_type = 'drift.detected' AND data->>'detector' = 'optwin' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) UNION ALL SELECT occurred_at AS time, agent_id || ' recent' AS metric, (data->'details'->>'recent_size')::int AS value FROM other_events WHERE event_type = 'drift.detected' AND data->>'detector' = 'optwin' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) ORDER BY 1
